arguments.name: Trinity as single axiom paying four debts
arguments.speaker: Framework author
arguments.conclusion: The Trinitarian God is the single axiom that grounds existence, distinction, relation, and orientation, which every other ontology assumes but cannot derive.
premises: Every formal system has an unprovable floor (set theory nine axioms, Peano five, GR two postulates).
Every system uses four things it cannot ground: existence, distinction, relation, orientation.
The Trinity pays all four from one structure: aseity grounds existence, the persons ground distinction, perichoresis grounds relation, love grounds orientation.
No other ontology derives these four; they are assumed and never paid for.

arguments.name: Unprovability as signature of Layer 0
arguments.speaker: Framework author
arguments.conclusion: The inability to prove God is not a weakness but the predicted signature of a genuine root layer.
premises: An axiom that could be proven would rest on something deeper and thus not be the ground.
The derivation grammar predicts a genuine Layer 0 requires nothing beneath it (DG1).
If God could be proven, God would not be the ground.
Godel guarantees this structural limit.

arguments.name: Physics as created medium for love
arguments.speaker: Framework author
arguments.conclusion: God made physics not from need but because creatures capable of freely receiving and returning love require an ordered, non-divine, consequential, temporal, limited, repairable world.
premises: God is free and creation is a gift, not a necessity.
Beings who can genuinely receive and return love need a world that is not God, stable enough to be known, with real consequence, time, limits, and repair.
Physics is the grammar of that world, not the Author.
Physics provides existence/distinction, relation/lawfulness, consequence/cost, time/sequence, and embodiment/public meaning.

arguments.name: Physics is not grace
arguments.speaker: Framework author
arguments.conclusion: Physics describes the condition grace answers but is not itself grace.
premises: Grace is God's unmerited favor entering creation from beyond the closed system.
Physics says closed systems run down and open systems can receive from outside.
Gravity is gravity and grace is grace; they are distinct.
A world with gravity is the kind of world where grace can be received as rescue rather than ignored as optional.

arguments.name: Ten forces compose a portrait of one Person
arguments.speaker: Framework author
arguments.conclusion: The measured properties of ten physical structures, read together, compose a portrait so specific that only one Person in history matches it.
premises: Physics tells what each force does, not why.
Gravity's properties (weakest, universal, unshieldable, always attractive, infinite range, patient, curves paths) match grace.
The strong force's properties (strongest, confinement, slack at short range, holds nuclei) match love, and the Hessian matrix independently scored it as the most connected node.
Electromagnetism's properties (self-sustaining light, no degradation, maximum speed, Maxwell's four equations) match truth.
Thermodynamics, information, and other laws similarly map to necessity, the Word, and other divine attributes.

arguments.name: You Are God narrative sequence
arguments.speaker: Framework author
arguments.conclusion: The nine-step sequence from God's self-sufficient goodness to cross and resurrection holds when first principles are stated in the right order.
premises: God is self-sufficient goodness; love freely creates real others.
Real others require genuine agency; agency allows refusal; refusal closes the receiver against the source.
A closed system decays; restoration must come from outside without destroying freedom.
Incarnation enters the system without coercing it; cross and resurrection restore from within while preserving identity.

arguments.name: Free witness and the tree
arguments.speaker: Framework author
arguments.conclusion: A free witness is required because appreciation that cannot refuse is not appreciation, and the tree is free will made visible.
premises: A mirror does not count; appreciation that cannot refuse is an echo.
Love creates because abundance overflows into real others who can answer freely.
Freedom without a real choice is just a word, like being free to leave a room with no door.
The adversary merely asks 'Did God really say...?' and independence starts sounding like an upgrade.

arguments.name: Proximity does not guarantee loyalty
arguments.speaker: Framework author
arguments.conclusion: God need not be made impossible to miss because seeing is not choosing and real love requires faith.
premises: The adversary was in heaven, saw God directly, and still rebelled.
Proximity never guaranteed loyalty.
Seeing is not the same as choosing.
Faith is the only proof of love that cannot be faked by proximity.

arguments.name: Cross and empty tomb as physics claims
arguments.speaker: Framework author
arguments.conclusion: The cross is successful deployment of the uncorrupted pattern into the broken system, and the empty tomb proves information survives its container and entropy is locally reversed from outside.
premises: On the cross the perfect pattern voluntarily releases itself into the broken system; 'It is finished' is not defeat.
The temple veil tears top to bottom, opened by God not human hands.
The adversary orchestrated the killing blow and triggered the mechanism that ends him.
The empty tomb shows information survives destruction of its container and entropy is locally reversed by connecting to an external source.

arguments.name: Honest limit and kill conditions
arguments.speaker: Framework author
arguments.conclusion: The argument could be wrong and names its own kill conditions in advance, distinguishing it from God-of-the-gaps arguments.
premises: The match between ten physical structures and ten spiritual patterns could be coincidence.
A determined skeptic could write the exact opposite essay from the same raw physics.
It does not need science to fail anywhere; it needs science to keep succeeding and the pattern to keep holding.
It names its kill conditions in advance so anyone can check.

arguments.name: Agency as the repeated structural gap
arguments.speaker: Framework author
arguments.conclusion: All ten law-to-spiritual mappings share the exact same missing piece in the same structural spot: agency.
premises: Each of the ten laws maps to a spiritual reading (gravity/grace, strong force/love, EM/truth, etc.).
Every mapping has the same missing piece: agency can be refused, rejected, suppressed, denied, ignored, abandoned, withheld, or broken.
The physics does not need the variable; the spiritual reading does.
This is one specific, nameable, checkable variable repeated ten times.

arguments.name: God in the completions, not the gaps
arguments.speaker: Framework author
arguments.conclusion: The framework inverts the God-of-the-gaps argument by showing that fully explained science, read together, describes a Person.
premises: God-of-the-gaps arguments shrink as science explains more (Darwin, plate tectonics, neuroscience).
This paper takes ten things science fully explained and shows they compose a portrait of a Person.
The more science explains, the clearer the portrait gets.
Bonhoeffer warned against using God as a stopgap; this framework makes the opposite argument and has data.

arguments.name: Cross-Resolution Method
arguments.speaker: Framework author
arguments.conclusion: Every major claim must be read in its proper register (theology, physics, mathematics, lived reality, bridge) with no hidden upgrades.
premises: Physics may not smuggle in theology; theology may not rescue weak physics.
Story may not pretend it is proof; formal proof may not pretend to capture lived experience.
When the same structure appears across registers, we mark the bridge, name its strength, state its limits, and keep testing.
No hidden upgrades.

arguments.name: Necessary ground argument
arguments.speaker: Framework author
arguments.conclusion: The source sustaining the universe must be necessary, self-grounding, origin of coherence, active, and personal, which matches classical divine attributes.
premises: If closed systems collapse and the universe has not collapsed, something external sustains it.
If coherence and decoherence are real, measurable, and universal, the source of coherence must be equally real and universal.
The required properties are: necessary, self-grounding, origin of coherence, active (passive maintenance is thermodynamically impossible), and personal (only persons ground moral facts).
These properties map to aseity, self-sufficiency, eternality, omnipresence, Logos, providence, and personhood.

arguments.name: The Descent: 24-step causal chain
arguments.speaker: Framework author
arguments.conclusion: Being, followed all the way down through 24 steps, arrives at the Cross.
premises: God creates; creation stands; what stands is distinguishable; distinction makes being intelligible; intelligibility carries information; information can stand in relation.
Relation can be kept or broken, revealing value; value opens moral valence; moral valence makes right and wrong meaningful; right and wrong require choosing agents.
Choice requires a world of rules, limits, time, and consequences, permitting decay and adversarial refusal.
Adversarial action creates debt; perfect Justice and Mercy together require a cost-bearing source beyond the damaged order; that source is Grace; Christ is the convergence point.

arguments.name: Progressive revelation as pedagogy
arguments.speaker: Framework author
arguments.conclusion: God reveals progressively because receivers cannot parse the full signal at once; He builds the reference frame piece by piece.
premises: God meets people in slavery, wilderness, under Law, through prophets, and in exile, each experience building vocabulary for rescue, provision, failure, pattern, and return.
Without the experience of failing to keep the Law, one cannot understand the Judge paying the debt Himself.
This is not God being slow but God being a teacher.
You do not teach calculus to a child who has not learned to count, not because calculus is untrue but because the child lacks the reference frame.

arguments.name: Evidence converges from every direction
arguments.speaker: Framework author
arguments.conclusion: Every path of inquiry converges on the same substrate because reality has one substrate that has been telling us its name since the beginning.
premises: Pre-human math: the sun used E=mc^2 for 4.6 billion years before Einstein.
Fine-tuning: the cosmological constant is tuned to 1 part in 10^120, which is signature not coincidence.
The Hubble Tension is a 5-sigma discrepancy that one framework resolves.
You can enter through logic, physics, information theory, biology, mathematics, cosmology, or moral measurement, and every path converges.

arguments.name: Canon reading order
arguments.speaker: Framework author
arguments.conclusion: The God pages must be read in a deliberate sequence: story first, equations second, gauntlet last.
premises: The sequence starts with God and story, moves through Trinity and Truth, then lets axioms carry the weight.
The 7Q Classifier comes after the foundation because it is not the doorway but the gauntlet.

The ten-step order runs from The Descent through God in the Equations, You Are God, Trinity Signature, Story With Receipts, Holding God Accountable, The Foundation, 7Q Classifier, Master Equation, and Ten Laws.

arguments.name: Cross-resolution status and accountability
arguments.speaker: Framework author
arguments.conclusion: The framework's claims have varying register strength and must be held accountable through declared bridges and adversarial testing.
premises: Theology and lived reality are strong; physics is modest (describes features, not why); the bridge is declared as structural correspondence, not proof.
Mathematics is partially formalized: the necessary ground argument has five proofs, but the ten-law mappings need adversarial testing.
God holds Himself accountable to truth, and science requires falsifiability.
The framework names its own kill conditions in advance, including a force with no matching structure.
